from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg: pts[g[i][j]].append((i,j))
    allpts=[p for c in pts for p in pts[c]]
    def line_id(a,b):
        i1,j1=a; i2,j2=b
        if i1==i2: return ('r',i1)
        if j1==j2: return ('c',j1)
        if i1-j1==i2-j2: return ('d',i1-j1)
        if i1+j1==i2+j2: return ('a',i1+j1)
        return None
    def online(lid,p):
        i,j=p
        t,v=lid
        return {'r':i==v,'c':j==v,'d':i-j==v,'a':i+j==v}[t]
    def seg(a,b):
        return frozenset((i,j) for i in range(min(a[0],b[0]),max(a[0],b[0])+1)
                                for j in range(min(a[1],b[1]),max(a[1],b[1])+1)
                         if online(line_id(a,b),(i,j)))
    claimed={}
    for c,ps in pts.items():
        if len(ps)<2: continue
        best=None
        for x in range(len(ps)):
            for y in range(x+1,len(ps)):
                lid=line_id(ps[x],ps[y])
                if lid is None: continue
                key=(sum(1 for p in allpts if online(lid,p)), len(seg(ps[x],ps[y])))
                if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,lid,ps[x],ps[y])
        if best and best[1] not in claimed:
            claimed[best[1]]=(c,frozenset(seg(best[2],best[3])))
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    ptset=set(allpts)
    for c,s in claimed.values():
        for i,j in s: out[i][j]=c
    for i,j in ptset: out[i][j]=g[i][j]
    # emissions: points of color d on another color's drawn segment
    emis=[]
    for lid,(c,s) in claimed.items():
        for p in ptset:
            if g[p[0]][p[1]]!=c and p in s:
                t,v=lid
                pt=p[0]+p[1] if t=='d' else (p[0]-p[1] if t=='a' else None)
                if t=='r': cells=[(p[0],j) for j in range(w)]
                elif t=='c': cells=[(i,p[1]) for i in range(h)]
                elif t=='d': cells=[(i,i-pt) for i in range(h) if 0<=i-pt<w]
                else: cells=[(i,pt-i) for i in range(h) if 0<=pt-i<w]
                emis.append((g[p[0]][p[1]],frozenset(cells)))
    for c,s in emis:
        for i,j in s:
            if (i,j) not in ptset: out[i][j]=c
    return out
